name: sapphire
description: Sapphire OS — multi-agent dispatch, token governance, verification, factory automation

tools.name: sapphire_dispatch
tools.description: Route a development task to the optimal inference tier (T0=Nemotron free, T1=Kimi subscription, T3=Claude expensive). Classifies task complexity via Nemotron, checks token budget, executes on cheapest capable tier.

tools.name: sapphire_verify
tools.description: Run lint (ruff) and tests (pytest) on a repo. Returns pass/fail status and whether it's safe to commit. Use after making code changes.

tools.name: sapphire_budget
tools.description: Show token usage per inference tier for today. Shows T0 (Nemotron/free), T1 (Kimi), T3 (Claude) with budget bars and call counts.

tools.name: sapphire_state
tools.description: Read/write persistent factory state. Tracks known issues, fix attempts, backoff timers. Prevents re-attempting failed fixes.

tools.name: sapphire_status
tools.description: Query Sapphire mesh status — Tailscale devices, Ollama models on GPU and local.

tools.name: sapphire_notify
tools.description: Send a Telegram notification via NemotronRariBot. Priority: p0=urgent, p1=normal, p2=low.

tools.name: sapphire_market
tools.description: Unified market data — equity quotes, crypto OHLCV, FRED macro, news via OpenBB (32 providers) + TradingView live chart data, Pine Script CI. Actions: quote, crypto, historical, fred, news, snapshot, tv_quote, tv_ohlcv, tv_levels, tv_strategy, pine_ci.
